chapter: 14 The Midgard Serpent: the motorcycle in the statue room after the arrival cinematic; mounted there and ridden off (docs/matrix/14_midgard_serpent.md C14-06, C14-07)
note: l4_traprooms entered inside the arrival cinematic's volume, as ch14_traprooms_club_throne. The motorcycle is one instance for the chapter, born in l4_trailstart (5482) and ridden from unit to unit; l4_traprooms names `motorcycle` among its DRM's object dependencies without placing one [O data], so a game loaded here has it. A level load that is not a save's has no place for it: it exists unplaced (World::bikeEntry [I]) until the arrival cinematic 5703's handlers stand it on marker 5704 with instance 26 [O bytecode], which finds it only because its script instance lives in her unit (script::Runtime::travel / away). She walks to its mount spot, Interact gets her on, and the throttle rides it across the hall. In a play-through she rides in and the cinematic's larabase 53 puts her back on it; here she arrived on foot (Lara's vehicle pointer is empty), so 53 does nothing and she mounts by hand.
